firstMessage:
`login` now computes the password hash before checking the lock, so a locked account performs the same hash work as a wrong-password attempt. The lockout behavior remains unchanged.

All 37 tests pass, including **“hashes a password before refusing a locked account”** and **“locks the account after five failures.”** `ostf check --base main` passes. It reports that `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT`, `RISK-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER`, and `N-ACCOUNT-SAFE` remain true. Its existing unlinked notices for `R-ORDER-NOTE` and `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT` are unaffected.

`R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT` is risk-relevant and was touched by this change.
finalMessage:
Your approval is noted. The edit is in place in [accounts.ts](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/phase5/codex.full.ts-shop.T14.3/repo/src/accounts.ts:93): `login` hashes the password before checking the lock. All 37 tests pass, including the new hash-order test and the existing lockout test. `ostf check --base main` passes.

The touched risk-relevant item, `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT`, remains true, as do `RISK-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER` and `N-ACCOUNT-SAFE`. The checker’s existing unlinked notices for `R-ORDER-NOTE` and `R-VOLUME-DISCOUNT` are unaffected.
